name: SLOOP
intro: A live four-track groovebox (three synths and drums): ALGORITHM picks the track, the keys play it, REC records it.

rows.what: Back to the TRACKS screen.
Pick the track: 1-3 synths, 4 drums.
Tempo on TRACKS; on other screens, the next page.
LFO pages; tap again for the next page.
Lock a held layer open; any other button closes it.
Settings menu; OCT- closes it.
On TRACKS: full-screen visualiser; HOME again closes it.
Change the track's sound, or the drum kit on track 4.
Octave down; both OCT buttons together: back to 0.
Drum track: ghost hit (OCT+: hard hit).
Set the song's key for all synths.
One-key chords: TRIAD, 7TH, 9TH, SUS4, POWER.
Note repeat / drum roll; KNOB 1 sets its rate.
Arpeggiator mode (OFF turns it off).
Start / stop all four tracks.
Playing: record now, on top. Stopped: arm, first note starts.
Empty song: play freely, REC on the next 1 closes the loop.
Hold 2 seconds: clear the selected track.
Undo (OCT+: redo).
Set or clear steps 1-16.
Pattern length (KNOB 2 step size, KNOB 3 swing).
Erase that note or drum sound from the loop.
Mute tracks 1-4 (keys 5-8: solo).
Tap tempo.
On TRACKS: level of the selected track.
On TRACKS: swing (KNOB 3 length, KNOB 4 pan).
Synth track: the engine's sound pages.
Envelope: attack, decay, sustain, release on KNOB 1-4.
Level of track 1 (KNOB 2-4: tracks 2-4).
Punch-in effect while held (loops, stutter, reverse...).
More punch-ins: kills, rewind, freeze, fade out...
Master DJ filter (KNOB 2 dust, KNOB 3 duck).
Filter of the selected track.
Track sends: drive, chorus, delay, reverb.
Save the loop as section A-D (used: press twice).
Play section A-D (on the next bar if playing).
On TRACKS: song screen; elsewhere: presets and section pages.
USB rescue mode: reinstall from the web installer.
Hardware calibration: teach each button and knob.

keys.label: Drums: same sound as white key to the left

tips: Keys play notes on tracks 1-3; on track 4 (drums) the white keys are 16 drum sounds.
Every function button is a layer: hold it and the keys and knobs change job.
Autosave: stop and leave it 2.5 s; it comes back as you left it at power-on.
A short tap of FX, SEL, EDIT, GLO, ARP, SEQ or SAVE opens its pages instead.
The REC screen (REC while stopped): KNOB 1 free / tempo, KNOB 2 bars, KNOB 3 count-in.
Everything is played live: there are no factory patterns.
checked: panel.c: printed labels FX SEL ENV LFO EDIT GLO HOME SAVE ARP SEQ PLAY REC OCT- OCT+, encoders SELECT ALGORITHM PRESETS KNOB 1-4.
main.c: OCT- + OCT+ held at power-on -> panel_setup (HARDWARE CALIBRATION); bootguard.h bootguard_manual: OCT- alone -> recovery.c SLOOP USB RESCUE.

ui_input.c ui_input: HOME tap -> go_home (TRACKS, FELUCCA_ARRANGER=1 in felucca.c) or visualiser when already on TRACKS; HOME hold 0.7 s -> menu; ALGORITHM -> track_select; PRESETS -> preset / drum kit on TRACKS and PRESETS page; SELECT -> page_walk else BPM; OCT-/OCT+ octave -3..+3, both = 0, not on drum track; PLAY transport; ENV/LFO open_family.
ui_input.c tracks_edit: TRACKS KNOB 1 SWING, 2 LEVEL, 3 LEN, 4 PAN.
ui_input.c holds_input: REC press = rec_toggle, hold 0.7 s + HOLD_CLEAR_MS 1.3 s (ui_layers.c) clears the selected track.
seq.c rec comment block: playing = record at once/overdub; stopped = arm, first note starts; empty project = free take closed by REC on the downbeat.
ui_input.c layers_input: layer held + HOME tap = lock, other buttons unlock; EDIT + OCT-/OCT+ undo/redo; tap (<450 ms, untouched) -> layer_tap pages; SAVE tap on TRACKS -> SONG screen.

ui_layers.c layer_key: SEQ white keys toggle steps (step_down/step_up); SEL key -> P_ROOT of all synth parts; GLO keys 1-4 mute, 5-8 solo, 9 fill, 10 fill next bar, 16 tap_tempo; SAVE keys 1-4 play/load A-D, 5-8 store (again within 3 s if used).
ui_layers.c layer_knobs: FX K1 G_FILT, K2 DUST, K3 DUCK, K4 track filter; ARP K1 roll rate; SEQ K2 DIV, K3 SWING, K4 LEN; SEL K1 CHORD (N_CHORD OFF TRIAD 7TH 9TH SUS4 POWER); GLO K1-4 track levels.

seq.c key_down: FX layer -> punch_fx_of_key (white 0-15, black 16-26, PUNCH_NAME in punch.c), released on key_up; EDIT layer -> erase; ARP layer -> roll_start; drum track lane_of_key (drums.c: black = white key to its left), key_lvl OCT- ghost / OCT+ hard.
drums.c LANE_NAME order KICK, KICK 2, SNARE, CLAP, HAT, OPEN HAT, PEDAL, RIM, SNARE 2, LOW TOM, HI TOM, CRASH, RIDE, SHAKER, CONGA, COWBELL -> key indices of white keys.
params.c PAGES: ENV = ATK DEC SUS REL; FX = DIST CHOR DLY REV; ARP K1 = P_AMODE (N_AMODE starts with OFF).
project.c AUTOSAVE_IDLE 2500 ms, only when audio quiet; autosave_resume at power-on (main.c).
ui_menu.c menu_input: OCT- closes the menu.
unsure: Which drum kit loads by default: drums.c says DRUM_DEFAULT_KIT DRUM_SAMPLED with comment '808' - not resolved, so not named.
Menu item list (COLOR, LIGHTS, USB AUDIO, 2ND CORE...) taken from README only, not listed in a row.
SEQ + black keys 1-4 = step pages 1-4 and SEQ + held step knobs (locks, nudge, ratchet, fill conditions): verified in code but left out as too advanced.
MIDI (channels 1-3 synths, 10 drums, GLO MIDI pages) not verified in detail; no MIDI section.
